injection.name: Injected context
compaction.name: Compacted context
compaction.pending: folding the front of this conversation into one summary
compaction.pendingBody: This conversation is over the threshold, so the front of it is being folded into one summary. That is a model call over everything up here, so it takes a while — the result row lands below this one when it answers.
compaction.failedReason: This conversation was over the threshold, so the harness tried to fold its front into one summary -- and the model call for that summary did not come back. Nothing was folded: the conversation is exactly as long as it was, and the next turn will try again.
timeout.name: Model timeout
timeout.reason.retrying: The model produced no data for {{ms}}ms, so the call was cut off as a dead connection. This is attempt {{attempt}}, and up to {{limit}} retries are allowed.
timeout.reason.partial: The model went quiet for {{ms}}ms after it had already answered part of this turn. Retrying would show that half-written answer twice, so the run ended here instead.
timeout.reason.exhausted: The model produced no data for {{ms}}ms on {{attempt}} attempts in a row, and the {{limit}} retries this session allows are spent. The run ended here.
